HORT.gloss: mode proposal 'let us'; dropped subject = we

SUGQ.gloss: mode proposal asking agreement 'shall we ..., OK?'; dropped subject = we

DELIB.gloss: mode 'should I ...?' asking for a decision; dropped subject = I

Q.gloss: mode yes/no question; dropped subject = I

ET.gloss: and (+NP: NP list; +V/OP: clause sharing the subject, inside the current conjunct)

LK.gloss: of (X LK Y = Y of X)

REL.gloss: relative clause on the preceding NP (gap = missing role)

PD.gloss: clause boundary (only where two nouns would otherwise compound)

QT.gloss: raw span: next chunk + following chunks with uppercase/digit/symbol

POINT.gloss: decimal / version point; digits after it are read one by one
